intro.title: What this site is
intro.body: BaerimTools is an unofficial, fan-made tool created for players of the Baerim server (Metin2). The site is not affiliated with the Baerim team or the creators of Metin2. You don't need an account or to log in to use it.

localData.title: Data stored locally in your browser
localData.intro: The site saves some data purely locally, in your browser's storage (localStorage) — this data is never sent to any server and disappears if you clear your browsing data. It's used to remember your settings and progress between visits:
items: your chosen site language and night mode
the Metin2 nickname you entered (used to credit you in the Hall of Fame)
your list of collected mokoko on the interactive maps
comments you've liked under mokoko markers
your own manually entered material prices and your Build Calculator list
short-lived cooldowns after using a banned word in a comment

serverData.title: Data sent to the server
serverData.body: If you add a comment under a mokoko on the map (optionally with a photo), submit a price to the global price list, or leave your nickname for the Hall of Fame — that data is stored in the site's database (Supabase) and is publicly visible to other visitors. Please don't include personal information in comments — it's never needed.

hostingLogs.title: Hosting logs
hostingLogs.body: Like most websites, the hosting infrastructure (Vercel) and database (Supabase) behind this site may routinely log IP addresses and basic technical request information (e.g. browser type) as part of normal service operation and security. We don't have direct access to this data beyond basic statistics.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can delete locally stored data at any time by clearing your browsing data for this site. If you'd like us to remove a comment, photo, or Hall of Fame entry you submitted, write to us at the address below.

changes.title: Changes to this policy

communityGuide.title: Baerim Compendium
communityGuide.subtitle: Community-collected questions and answers, organized in one place for quick browsing.
communityGuide.disclaimerBody: the answers below were generated by AI based on Discord chat transcripts. They may contain inaccuracies or outdated information — when in doubt, verify directly on the server.
communityGuide.footerNote: Unofficial material · compiled from Baerim community discussions

items.q: How does the One Account Scroll work?
items.a: It applies to the account it was activated on, covering every character on that account. It does not carry over to a second account. It can be turned off, but doing so loses the scroll.

items.q: Can I activate the One Account Scroll on two accounts and farm metins on both?
items.a: No. The chat answer was unambiguous: you can't get around the limit this way.

items.q: With the One Account Scroll active, can I still fish or mine ore on a second account?
items.a: Yes, a second account can still be used for fishing and mining.

items.q: How does the Casual Buff and the metin limit work?
items.a: It boosts drops from metins, but a daily limit of around 1500 metins applies, counted across the board. The chat also mentioned a link to dungeon bonuses.

items.q: Does the double-drop event affect shrines?
items.a: According to chat answers, it no longer doubles shrines themselves; the remaining loot may still be covered by the bonus.

items.q: Where's the best place to farm the Moonlight Chest event — dungeons or metins?
items.a: On metins.

items.q: Does the 10% double-drop bonus/buff from metins apply to the Moonlight Chest?
items.a: Answers in chat were contradictory here — one person said "no," another said "it should work" — so there's no clear answer.

items.q: Which level should you stop EXP at — 54 or 55?
items.a: Level 55 was most often recommended, as long as the character already has enough damage and survivability for the Demon Tower.

items.q: Is it worth farming metins at higher levels, e.g. 70/75/80/90?
items.a: In the conversations analyzed, staying at 55 was often recommended, since higher-level metins were seen as not worth the effort.

items.q: How do you earn yang outside of dungeons and metins?
items.a: The most common answers were mining, farming the Temple, and buying cheap items to resell at a higher price. For mining, a P skill and a +5 or higher pickaxe were recommended.

items.q: Where's the best place to mine ore?
items.a: Map1 / City 1. One answer also noted that ore nodes respawn roughly every 30 minutes.

items.q: Which bonuses should you pick for a sash for PvE / Dragon?
items.a: 5% PvE versus elemental resistance came up often. One player recommended 5% PvE and covering resistance with elemental boots instead.

items.q: Is it more worth it to craft a sash yourself or buy a finished one?
items.a: Early in the game, collecting cloth and buying a finished sash was more often recommended, or crafting one later, e.g. around level 75.

items.q: How do you add bonuses to costumes?
items.a: The right items are sold by the merchant NPC. According to chat, it takes roughly 150–200 attempts on average to land 3 bonuses.

items.q: Can bonuses be rerolled on items evolved from level 54 to 81?
items.a: Yes, with regular reroll scrolls.

items.q: What's the best way to upgrade Soul EQ from +1 to +6?
items.a: Chat recommended: Dragon Scroll for +1–+3, a 100% scroll for +4, then a Magic Stone after that.

items.q: How much does rerolling bonuses in alchemy cost?
items.a: Per the answers: 1 Flame, no yang cost; the resulting bonus is random. Rerolling bonuses below Brilliant grade was discouraged.

items.q: Is it better to do mythic or legendary alchemy first?
items.a: The most common short answer: mythic.

items.q: What resistances do you need for Dragon? Why am I getting one-shot?
items.a: Magic resistance plus the matching element resistance were most often pointed to; magic resistance mainly on the helmet and bracelet, plus the right bonuses on the shield.

items.q: How do you fix lag/FPS drops when running two clients?
items.a: The most common advice: close the game and delete metin2.cfg. Capping FPS at 60 was also sometimes recommended.

items.q: Why does the game crash / reset settings / not go fullscreen?
items.a: Delete metin2.cfg, check config.exe, check your antivirus, reinstall the client, and if the problem persists — open a support ticket.

items.q: How do I buy DC / pay with Paysafecard?
items.a: This came up very often in the Polish chat. Payment goes through an external site; the field on the Baerim site was meant for gift card codes, not for entering a PSC code directly.

items.q: How does Skill Synergy work, and what needs to be maxed (P)?
items.a: For the full bonus, chat says you need all 6 main skills at P plus your buff skills at P; mining/fishing were not required for it.

items.q: What are the best first pet skills for PvM?
items.a: For a warrior, suggestions included Boss Guard → Magic/Melee Attack → Crit Power → Monster Hunter, depending on the character's needs.
